title: A Collusion-Resistant Byzantine Robust Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning Optimization Method

pse.problem: The federated learning method faces threats of poisoning and inference attacks during model training, affecting data privacy and reducing model performance.
pse.solution_function: The invention presents an anti-collusion Byzantine robust privacy protection federated learning optimization method that aims to defend against both poisoning and inference attacks. It employs a secure aggregation mechanism for local gradients and maintains their privacy, while also detecting malicious clients responsible for poisoning attacks.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of clients, a central server, and potentially a trusted dataset. Clients perform local model training and generate local gradients. The central server aggregates and processes the encrypted local gradients using secure multi-party computation or homomorphic encryption, ensuring data privacy. A trusted dataset is used for comparison to screen malicious clients.
pse.solution_implementation: The central server calculates a trusted local gradient from the trusted dataset. It then compares the cosine similarity between the local gradient uploaded by each client and the trusted gradient. Clients with significant deviations are flagged as potential malicious clients. The system also implements noise addition to local gradients for inference attack resistance.
pse.effect: The proposed method effectively defends against both poisoning and inference attacks, maintaining data privacy while preserving model accuracy.
